title: The mass measure of a current carried by planes through 0 splits over the punctured planes
statement: Let P, n, q ∈ ℕ with 1 ≤ n, let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), let R be an integer multiplicity representation of C in ℝ^P (R.Represents C) with mass measure μ := R.measure, and let P_1, …, P_q (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ ℝ^P) be linear subspaces of ℝ^P with P_i ∩ P_j = {0} (Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) for i ≠ j, such that every x ∈ spt C with x ≠ 0 lies in some P_i. Then μ(A) = Σ_{i ∈ Fin q} μ(A ∩ (P_i ∖ {0})) for every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n q : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → R.Represents C → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) → (∀ x ∈ C.support, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, x ∈ Ps i) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∑ i, R.measure (A ∩ ((Ps i : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0}))
